column1: # The substitution names of the profile commands (PROFILE.md «Command ownership and build results», «Substitutions»). PROFILE.md refers to this form and does not repeat it.
# One row per (section, key). section: stand, adapters or vectors. key: the command name of stand, the adapter name, or * for every entry of vectors.
# owners: JSON array of the Platform modules whose profile may declare the key; a shared algorithm name is admitted to every module except 07-console-module, and admission assigns no package.
# names: JSON array of the substitution names available to the template, nothing else. required: JSON array of the names the template must contain;
# the exact flags of the command store, the assignment of AGENT_TOKEN_DIR and the address form of token-door are in the prose of PROFILE.md «Substitutions».
